_comment: Top-level config for all_code.py -- holds paths to each pipeline stage's own config file, not the stage settings themselves. Each stage documents and owns its own schema (see flake_detection/config.py, grid_preperation/config.py); edit those files' own JSON configs to tune detection/export behavior, edit this file only to point at a different config file entirely.
_comment_input_folder: Folder of raw chip images to run the pipeline over. --input_folder on the command line overrides this.
